name: TEP·SOUND cue library
_comment: The cue catalogue this module's shipped protocols draw from.
Every cue here is text or a flat colour, so the module runs on a machine that has never seen
this lab and a protocol can be checked before any image exists. Replace `kind` with `image`
and give a `src` relative to this file to use the real pictures; nothing else changes.
`legacyCode` is the integer the same picture had in the lab's StimulusList_*.js files, so an
analysis written against the old marker numbers still reads a recording made here.

welcome.text: Please relax and keep your eyes on the centre of the screen.
welcome.label: Welcome

goodbye.text: Thank you — the session is finished.
goodbye.label: Goodbye
